name: Agnes & Talia: Revisited
source:
Being a teenager only exists in stories; it isn't real, it doesn't happen.

Set approximately in "high school" and "adolescence" and "the past" and "fiction" as the kind of passing thought one might have walking between classes or freaking out for no apparent reason.

[Edited from [url=https://moonscraps.itch.io/agnes-and-talia-revisited]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
所谓“十几岁的少年时代”只存在于故事里；它并不真实，也从未发生过。

本作大致设定在“高中”“青春期”“过去”与“虚构”的交界处，宛如课间走在走廊上时一闪而过的杂念，又或是毫无来由地一阵心慌意乱。

[摘自[url=https://moonscraps.itch.io/agnes-and-talia-revisited]itch.io[/url]（经编辑）]
